general.autostart_desc: Gemini Tray starts in the background after you sign in to Windows
general.start_minimized_desc: Only show the tray icon on start, no window
general.language_desc: Used for settings, menus and messages

shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts work system-wide. Click a key and press the new combination; Delete removes the shortcut.
shortcuts.dictation_desc: Works in any app, the text lands in your clipboard
shortcuts.screenshot_desc: Select an area and hand it to Gemini
shortcuts.newChat_desc: Open the window and start a new conversation
shortcuts.prompts_desc: Pick a saved prompt for your next message
shortcuts.taken: Already used by another app – please choose a different combination
shortcuts.needs_modifier: Please combine with Alt, Ctrl, Shift or Win

account.title: Google account
account.desc: Gemini Tray uses your Google account in the Gemini window. If Google refuses sign-in inside the window, sign in with Chrome or Edge – the session is taken over.
account.reset_desc: Signs you out and deletes all data of the Gemini window

not_available.title: Not available yet
not_available.body: This feature will follow in a later version.

recovered.title: Settings reset
recovered.body: The settings file was damaged. Defaults are used again.

taken.title: Shortcut in use
taken.body: Used by another app: {detail}. You can change it in the settings.

required.title: Sign-in required
required.body: Sign in in the window. If that fails: tray menu › Sign in with browser.

browser_started.title: Browser opened
browser_started.body: Sign in to Google in the browser window. It closes automatically afterwards.

success.title: Signed in
success.body: Your Google session was taken over.
